declarations.name: AuiScrollArea
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Scroll Area: `
...
`. Enhances the element in place (native scrolling, edge fades, a focusable region while it overflows); the projected content stays Angular-managed.

inputs.name: maxBlockSize
inputs.description: Maximum block size as a CSS length (sets --aui-scroll-area-max-block-size).

inputs.name: shadows
inputs.description: Fade the edges where more content exists.

accessibility.pattern: Scrollable region (WCAG 2.1.1): a scrollable element that holds no focusable content must itself be focusable and named; it is a region with aria-label while it overflows.

limitations: Size changes deeper than the direct children are noticed when a direct child resizes; call refresh() after other changes.
The fades also fade content at the edge; avoid placing controls there.
